extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology from primary results, figure captions, methods, and discussion; automated pending-review placeholders were replaced.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TEM supports P. aeruginosa PaO1 envelope damage after 6xHis-Hill_BB_C10074 exposure, including leakage, blebbing, lysis, debris, and spherocyte-like cells.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: 6xHis-Hill_BB_C10074 against P. aeruginosa PaO1 whole cells
mechanism_claims.limitations: TEM morphology supports membrane/envelope disruption but does not identify a receptor or prove exact pore stoichiometry in cells.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: EIS on P. aeruginosa PaO1 OMV-supported lipid bilayers supports direct outer-membrane-model disruption by 6xHis-Hill_BB_C10074 across 5-500 ug/mL.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: 6xHis-Hill_BB_C10074 against P. aeruginosa PaO1 OMV-supported lipid bilayers
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a membrane-model assay, not a whole-cell MIC; buffer effects are preserved as a caution.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: AF2/Dali structural analysis supports a porin-like homotrimeric beta-barrel rationale for Gram-negative outer-membrane interaction.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Prediction and homology are supportive rationale; direct mechanism strength comes from TEM and EIS.
